layout.arrangement: Outer red frame; centered title near top; yellow page badge top-right; three stacked red-bordered panels. Each panel: left summed/scalar equations, magenta right double-arrow, center row/matrix-times-column equation, right blue underlined constraint-count label above red/blue 'Ax=b'.

visual_elements.note: tall parentheses around row/column vectors and matrices; colored series: a-series blue, b-series magenta, c-series green, x-column red, numeric matrix/rhs black; right-side labels are plain text: blue underlined 'One/Three/Four Constraints' above red 'Ax=b'

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Calibri/Arial-like); math variables italic, operators upright. Title bold red ~30 pt centered title case. Body equations ~18-20 pt left-aligned; matrix equations centered within panel. Constraint labels ~15-16 pt blue underlined title case right-aligned. 'Ax=b' ~18 pt bold red with blue x [?]. Badge numeral ~14 pt black.
